message: No detected input validation: The code relies entirely on Gradio Slider widgets to constrain input ranges but performs no explicit schema, dtype, or value-range validation in Python before passing data to the model.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the provided code; data is read from local paths (train_data_path) with no checksum, signature, or authentication checks.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing pipeline applies imputation and scaling but no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is present.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models (e.g., via predict_one_sample using config.SAVED_MODELS) and saves them with save_file, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before loading any model artifact.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label set, or anomalous sample distribution before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used in any part of the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (accuracy, AUC, F1) are computed, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no explicit held-out test set isolation mechanism, and no guard against leakage between training folds and evaluation data.

No detected input sanitization: Inputs come from Gradio sliders with min/max bounds set in the UI, but there is no server-side validation, shape check, range enforcement, or schema validation before passing args to predict_one_sample.

No detected output bounds checks: The predict function directly returns pred_probs and predicted_class from predict_one_sample without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular water-potability classifier, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
